purpose: Replace three generic drone views with visually stronger, geographic 360-degree aerial panoramas; do not alter currently published five-location game until photo assets have passed licensing/image/availability tests.
safetyRules: No live game metadata or manifest changes while media files are unavailable.
Photos must be 2:1 equirectangular at least 5000x2500; source licenses and actual coordinates validated before upload.
Use new unique IDs for image asset publication, not in-place overwrites with stale cached media.
All four static cube-face previews must exist and work before enabling a location.
After publication align src/data/dronePanoramas.ts, src/lib/droneHints.ts, manifests, API session and licensed credit.
No Vercel deployment or TestFlight build until requested; network endpoint and native static asset availability must be tested.
